evals.prompt: Review the export branch against SPEC.md.
evals.expected_output: Saves the branch diff to a file, runs the reviewer role with only the spec and that diff (read-only, no conversation), and reports gaps tied to spec items with file, line and a concrete failing input.

evals.prompt: Review this diff: it only renames two variables.
evals.expected_output: Reports 'No gaps' instead of inventing issues or listing style preferences.

evals.prompt: Review my staged changes; there is no spec.
evals.expected_output: Writes the stated requirements into a short file, says the review is against that, and reviews the diff against it.
